RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "(No SAs are created in response to receipt of a packet that requires IPsec protection; only BYPASS or DISCARD cache entries can be created this way.) If there is no match, discard the traffic." Same producers and paths as RFC4301-5.2-1: applyConfig dropped the ICMP error return entries (now kernel-mapped) and added a start-time log of port-scoped forward bypasses that installs nothing; the catch-all is still first on the first apply and last in releaseSPD, kept when warnSPDLeft reports an entry left. VPP still holds no catch-all and the OSPF manual-key entries still lack a final DISCARD outside the engine's window. The gap stands.
